summary: Mixed Martial Arts Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K on June 16, 2026, announcing termination of a $20 million equity line of credit with American Ventures LLC and confirmation that no drawdowns ever occurred. The company also confirmed no funds were drawn under a separate $5 million unsecured revolving loan facility. This is a routine capital structure simplification, not an acquisition, tender offer, restructuring, or other special situation. No deal terms, premium, board recommendation, or regulatory clock apply. The filing simply removes uncertainty around unused facilities; no event-driven risk-arb angle exists.
